title: Spatial group nesting depth
summary: For each spatial group, how many progressively larger spatial domains contain it.

third_party.name: julia
third_party.note: Read from the image. Manifest.toml records 1.9.0, so the lockfile and the runtime disagree; the image is what executes. The RNG stream is a language guarantee, so this matters under a fixed seed.

environment.provenance: Digest read from the build on randi dated 2026-07-02. The recipe cannot regenerate it: build_r_container.sh resolves CRAN against 'latest' rather than a dated snapshot, so this file is currently the only record of the versions below.

inputs.name: node_parents
inputs.description: Ancestor chain for every node in the tree.

inputs.name: node_leaves
inputs.description: Spots beneath every node, with coordinates.

inputs.name: sg_pairs
inputs.description: The spatial group pairs whose depth is measured.

inputs.name: positions
inputs.description: Spot coordinates. Only the millimetre columns are used.

outputs.name: depths
outputs.description: One nesting depth per spatial group. Zero means peripheral and standalone.

determinism.note: Fully deterministic. Given identical inputs the output is identical, which makes this the safest place to prove an adapter pattern.

resources.scales_with: number of nodes in the tree, and spots beneath each
resources.memory_hint: Comfortable well under 8 GB at Visium scale.

for_people: Reports how deeply each spatial group sits inside the tree of groups.
